title: PEA transcript v1 header
description: The header of a PEA transcript v1 file as a JSON object, for tools that pass transcripts around as JSON (a tool server's answer, an index). The file itself is plain text (SPEC.md section 4): line 1 gives `version`, lines 2 to 12 give the other eleven members in this order as `key: value`. Two members change shape: `speakers` is the list of names (the file writes them joined by ", ", or the word "none" for an empty list), and `segments` is a number. Rules that need the segment lines (H13, S1 to S6) cannot be stated here; validate.py checks them.

version.description: Line 1 of the file, "PEA-TRANSCRIPT v1". Rule H1.

show.description: The show's name, on one line. May be empty when not known. Rules H4, H14.

title.description: The episode's title, on one line. May be empty when not known. Rules H4, H14.

date.description: The episode's date, or "unknown". SHOULD be a calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD (W1). Rules H5, H14.

source.description: The public address the transcript was read from, or "unknown". Rules H6, H14.

duration.description: The episode's length: MM:SS under an hour (two digits each), H:MM:SS from one hour on (hours not padded), or "unknown". Rule H7.

language.description: The language of the text, or "unknown": 1 to 12 ASCII letters, digits, "-" and "_". SHOULD be a BCP 47 tag (W2). Rule H8.

format.description: What the transcript was written in before it was normalized. Rule H9.

provenance.description: Who made the text, in a few words. PEA writes "publisher transcript" (it never transcribes audio). Rules H10, H14.

quality.description: "full" when the whole transcript is in the file, otherwise "partial (reason)" with a reason of 1 to 120 characters; the file then ends with the cut mark " (cut)" (S4). Rules H11, H14.
examples: partial (cut at 150,000 chars; 481 of 680 segments kept, up to 40:00 of 56:40)
partial (the file was over 1.5 MB; end missing, kept up to 38:12)

speakers.description: The speakers' names in the order they first speak. Empty when the transcript names nobody (the file then says "none"). Rules H12, S3.

segments.description: The number of segment lines after the header. Rule H13.
